def shortest_cycle(graph, n):
    INF = 10**9
    ans = INF
    for start in range(n):
        dist = {start: 0}
        parent = {start: -1}
        q = deque([start])
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            for v in graph[u]:
                if v not in dist:
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1
                    parent[v] = u
                    q.append(v)

                    cycle_len = dist[u] + dist[v] + 1
                    ans = min(ans, cycle_len)
